labels: Publisher metadata only; no visual identity inference.
inputs: Six distinct exact original downloads, two different photographs per source-labelled person; not augmentations.

durableWorkerResult.modelReprocessingPreservesManualTracks: Separately verified with deterministic version/correction fixtures.

testBoundary: Six real YuNet/SFace subprocess inferences through the actual API-created durable jobs and FaceWorker. Library/Storage authorization and bytes are supplied by a controlled fixture adapter, not the live parent deployment. Private-container HTTP inference separately verified on an original portrait.

liveStackVerification.boundary: Actual Keycloak JWTs, exact-original uploads, hashing, Storage, RabbitMQ, Library projection and transactional outbox, automatic face jobs, private Linux CPU inference.
verified: Automatic indexing was observed before any manual enqueue.
Manual enqueue returns the existing durable job.
Cross-owner and shared-reader media access never exposes private face annotations.
An independent upload of identical bytes receives independent private identity/name state.
Names, aliases, merges, undo and splits persist across actual face-container restarts.
Pending compound and hidden companion images are denied; committed primary indexing is automatic.
Removing current library membership denies source access.
A real blank image produces no_faces, not an invented identity.
A faces-api-only outage leaves original upload/retrieval available and automatically recovers durable publication retries.
Admin disablement denies already-issued JWTs while an independent owner remains isolated.
Original bytes remain unchanged; disposable users, media and biometric annotations are cleaned up.
liveStackVerification.numerics: Small differences from the local Python matrix above reflect the actual Linux CPU runtime; threshold remained fixed.

limitations: This small set of well-lit frontal official portraits is not a family-photo accuracy benchmark.
It does not establish accuracy on children, occlusion, profiles, low light, mixed-age collections or demographic subgroups.
No threshold was changed in response to these portraits.
HEIC decoding is separately verified in heic-validation.json; physical-device Photos qualification and video-frame indexing remain incomplete.
The current base backup script does not protect the optional face database or its credentials; manual annotations are not rebuildable.
